passages.note: Forum answer on housing costs wishes to 'get rid of' the Trump tariffs found illegal — one set of tariffs, not 'most' or 'all', so it shows only the reduce-tariffs side.
Blames 'Donald Trump's illegal tariffs' for higher grocery prices; a complaint that names no tariff policy clause.
Says 'we're gonna fight against Trump' over 'the tariffs that are taxed' — opposition to the current federal tariffs, with no scope or level named.

rows.reasoning: Becerra's own words oppose the current Trump tariffs ("if we can get rid of the Trump taxes, the tariffs that are now being found illegal"), which shows the lower-tariff side. Removing one set of tariffs does not meet "reduce most tariffs, keeping only limited exceptions" or "eliminate all tariffs and pursue completely free trade with every country", and nothing he says separates those rungs.
